About this item

  • ☆【RAM, ROM And Expandable】: 8GB/12GB RAM with 128GB/256GB internal storage for smooth multitasking, app usage and media storage; no expandable storage as card slot is not available; UFS 3.1 storage.
  • ☆【Display】: Large 6.78-inch AMOLED display with 1224 x 2720 pixels resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10+ support, 2160Hz PWM, up to 1600 nits HBM and 4500 nits peak brightness; protected by Corning Gorilla Glass 7i.
  • ☆【Camera】: Advanced triple rear camera setup with 50MP main camera with OIS, 50MP periscope telephoto camera with OIS and 3.5x optical zoom, 8MP ultrawide camera, plus 32MP front camera; supports 4K video recording, Ultra XDR, panorama, Dolby Vision HDR, gyro-EIS and OIS.
  • ☆【Processor】: Powered by Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 processor with octa-core CPU and Adreno 810 GPU for responsive performance; runs on Android 16 with Nothing OS 4.1 and supports up to 3 major Android upgrades; supports 5G connectivity.
  • ☆【Battery】: 5400mAh India battery with 50W wired fast charging; charging data as provided: up to 50% in 22 minutes and 100% in 64 minutes; includes USB Type-C, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, stereo speakers, in-display fingerprint sensor and IP64 dust and water resistance.

Product description

The Nothing Phone 4a 5G is built for users who want powerful performance, immersive visuals and versatile cameras in one device. It comes with a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with 120Hz refresh rate and HDR10+ support for smooth and vibrant viewing. Driven by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 processor, it supports efficient multitasking with 8GB or 12GB RAM and up to 256GB internal storage.Its triple rear camera system includes a 50MP main camera with OIS, a 50MP periscope telephoto camera with OIS and 3.5x optical zoom, and an 8MP ultrawide lens, while the 32MP front camera is designed for selfies and video calls. The phone also features 63 mini-LEDs with 6 individually addressable zones for a distinctive design touch.For everyday convenience, the Nothing Phone 4a 5G includes a 5400mAh battery for India, 50W fast charging, 5G connectivity, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, stereo speakers, IP64 dust and water resistance, and an in-display fingerprint sensor. It runs on Android 16 with Nothing OS 4.1.

    About this Item

    • ☆【RAM, ROM And Expandable】: 8GB/12GB RAM with 128GB/256GB internal storage for smooth multitasking, app usage and media storage; no expandable storage as card slot is not available; UFS 3.1 storage.

    • ☆【Battery】: 5400mAh India battery with 50W wired fast charging; charging data as provided: up to 50% in 22 minutes and 100% in 64 minutes; includes USB Type-C, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, stereo speakers, in-display fingerprint sensor and IP64 dust and water resistance.

    The Nothing Phone 4a 5G is built for users who want powerful performance, immersive visuals and versatile cameras in one device. The phone also features 63 mini-LEDs with 6 individually addressable zones for a distinctive design touch.For everyday convenience, the Nothing Phone 4a 5G includes a 5400mAh battery for India, 50W fast charging, 5G connectivity, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, stereo speakers, IP64 dust and water resistance, and an in-display fingerprint sensor.
